o: Bertha Russell changed Society at a cost. Now, her family must reckon with the consequences as Agnes van Rhijn seizes an opportunity to regain her position. Meanwhile, Marian forges a new path for herself, and Peggy works to be accepted by her future in-laws. In this new era, you must be careful what you wish for.

eps.o: Bertha faces Gladys’s difficult childbirth, Peggy achieves a milestone, and Agnes makes plans to host a prestigious dinner.
Bertha returns to a frosty household, Peggy’s career aspirations clash with the Newport crowd, and Agnes reluctantly gives an interview.
